card.name: Hyphen joints inside gene and cancer terms
card.fires_on: Partway through a compound term in a dosing section, at a hyphen or a split character. Typical cases are BRCA-Mutated, Non-Squamous, KRAS G12C-mutated and CCR5-antagonist.

modes.description: Hyphen or first letter after a hyphen in a term like Non-Squamous or Post-MI.

card.writes: Promotes coding and wild-type style tokens, which hints at gene or mutation vocabulary but is weak.
card.plain: It fires at the joining point inside compound terms such as gene-mutated cancer or non-squamous.
